item.title: What every SaaS product manager must know
item.description:
Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) is a dynamic industry where Product Managers (PMs) must focus on metrics, growth strategies, and customer retention to drive success. Understanding key SaaS metrics and applying the AARRR framework can help PMs make data-driven decisions, optimize their product, and scale efficiently.

In this guide, we’ll break down the essential SaaS metrics, explain the AARRR framework, and show how leading companies apply these principles.

SaaS Metrics: Measuring Success

SaaS businesses operate on recurring revenue, which means tracking key metrics is essential to maintaining growth and profitability.
